g.text: B · Catalogue type composition over time
Mw family = mw, mwb, mwc, mwr, mww, mwp. Subsets overlap “All types”; type selection is not random.
Different type mixtures can affect pooled comparisons. These plots do not establish equal completeness or scale equivalence.
